role: instrument check on the sealed confirmation set before any of it is spent: can the Judge be read on this cohort at all
not_authorization_evidence: no Skill, no Episode, no Harness change and no claim about NOAA utility. Development region only, and the sealed region is not read
overall_verdict_reason: structure failed (0 of 19 materialized series reach the 5760-point minimum, and 20 are needed); substrate double guard, public phenomenon were never reached, so they are neither passed nor failed;  the frozen screen itself returned REJECTED_STRUCTURE, so the readability probe was not run and no Outcome was opened

pre_registered.why_before_the_spend: unreadability cannot be diagnosed after the Outcome is opened: it looks like a null result.  Weather failed at a 24.4x eval-loss spread and T233 reads at 2.0x
pre_registered.sealed_rule: no index at or past g3_sourcing.SEALED_FROM_INDEX=3072 is read.  Every series is truncated to that prefix at load time and the truncation is asserted, so the constraint holds by construction
pre_registered.step_0_in_place: the data has to exist and be readable, and its path, series count, channel structure and shortest length are quoted verbatim from the frozen registry rather than recalled
pre_registered.step_1_outcome_blind: the frozen screening criteria in g3_sourcing, applied through its own functions: structure (min_train_series, min_eval_series, min_series_length), the substrate double guard, and the public phenomenon census.  Any one failing is NOAA_STRUCTURE_FAIL and step 2 does not run
pre_registered.step_2_readability_probe: identity baseline only, at the frozen development origins, read for eval-loss spread and largest single-series loss share against the frozen bars; pooled always, per_channel only when the channel structure supports it

criteria.rationale: Weather's Judge was unreadable at a 24.4x eval-loss spread and T233 reads at 2.0x; the bar is set once, between them, and is never moved to make a candidate pass

pre_registered.per_channel_rule: per_channel is measured only when the cohort has at least 2 training channels
pre_registered.delayed_reading_rule: the last development origin is read as the delayed block; its readings must be finite, strictly positive and not degenerate to a single value
verdicts: NOAA_HEALTH_PROCEED: every measured Consumer variant clears the frozen bars
PROCEED_POOLED_ONLY: pooled clears them and per_channel does not
NOAA_JUDGE_UNREADABLE: the readability probe ran and failed
NOAA_STRUCTURE_FAIL: an outcome-blind criterion failed, so the probe was not run
NOAA_DATA_MISSING: the data is not there or cannot be read

sealed_semantics.enforcement: every loaded series is sliced to [:3072] before any consumer sees it, and an assertion refuses to continue if any array is longer

manifest_entry.note: NOAA ISD hourly surface temperature, the sealed U (unseen-domain) pool. Stations are geographically dispersed across the US by a hash-ordered selection. Carries heavy, genuinely natural missingness -- which is the point: it is the one source whose defects nobody injected.

channel_structure.entity_field: entity_id, the NOAA ISD station identifier
channel_structure.note: there is no multi-channel matrix here: each record is one station's hourly series, so a per_channel Consumer treats each training series as its own channel

step_0_in_place.raw_note: listed by filesystem metadata only; not one byte of raw series content is read by this check

structure.criterion: at least 12 train plus 8 eval series, each at least 5760 long
structure.length_read_from: the frozen registry's length field, so no series value is read to decide this
structure.reason: 0 of 19 materialized series reach the 5760-point minimum, and 20 are needed

substrate_double_guard.criterion: both the train and the eval substrate guard call the series clean, for at least 20 of them
substrate_double_guard.not_reached_because: the screen returned REJECTED_STRUCTURE before the guards ran

public_phenomenon.criterion: at least 4 training series carry a publicly visible phenomenon
public_phenomenon.not_reached_because: the screen returned REJECTED_STRUCTURE before the census ran

frozen_screen_reach.note: the frozen roster's first Support origin is the sealed boundary itself, so the eval substrate guard necessarily reads into the sealed region.  Under this check's zero-read rule that guard cannot be completed on any cohort, NOAA included

step_2_readability_probe.reason: the outcome-blind screen did not pass, so the readability probe was not run and no Outcome was opened

context_partition.what_was_seen: series values on the prefix below index 3072, plus registry metadata

development_outcome_partition.why: the outcome-blind screen failed, so no Consumer was fitted and no Judge reading was taken by this check

sealed_partition.enforcement: every loaded series is sliced to [:3072] before any consumer sees it, and an assertion refuses to continue if any array is longer
sealed_partition.note: no NOAA series in the frozen materialization even reaches index 3072, so the boundary was never approached

prior_exposure_on_the_record.claim_under_test: this dataset was described as the last sealed reserve, never touched
prior_exposure_on_the_record.reading: these are this project's own NOAA reports; a reserve with outcome reports already written is not untouched.  Reported as found, not resolved here

g3_exposed_families_says.note: g3_sourcing.EXPOSED_FAMILIES lists noaa_global_hourly under the exposed weather family, while the frozen registry marks every one of its series certified_virgin.  Both readings are recorded; this check does not adjudicate between them
